description: This Java class 'ShowMap' provides an entry point (main method) that loads data from a CSV file using BaseMap, creates a 3D chart control with the loaded data, and displays it in a frame. It acts as a simple visualization launcher for mapping data related to 'maf' and 'dwell'.

classes.name: ShowMap
classes.description: A Java class that loads data and displays a 3D chart visualization in a frame.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application that loads data from CSV files, creates a 3D surface chart, and displays it.
